_help: Add each event once here. Flyer events need a local src image, title, date, startsAt, endsAt, time, lead, alt and reserve. Both the player and calendar update from this list; endsAt must include the America/New_York UTC offset (-05:00 winter, -04:00 summer). Events without src appear only in the calendar.
